title: Signature Deterministic Verdict Engine
description: A Signature original: every rule carries a machine-checkable proof that its verdict is deterministic, so no two overlapping rules can ever disagree. The engine compiles the whole policy into a decision diagram at load time, giving constant-time packet verdicts that are provably consistent. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Proof-Carrying Web Gate
description: A Signature original: the web-tier allow rule ships with a proof that port 80 can only ever redirect and never serve content. The proof is rechecked on every policy reload, so a mis-edit cannot silently reopen plain HTTP serving. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Single-Door SSH Enclave
description: A Signature original: the bastion rule is paired with a rotating one-time knock sequence, so even the allowed bastion address must present the current knock before port 22 answers. The sequence derives deterministically from time and a shared secret, needing no extra ports. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Tier-Sealed Database Ring
description: A Signature original: the database ring rule binds each allowed app-tier address to a short-lived capability token issued at deploy time. Stolen credentials alone cannot open a connection without a fresh token, so lateral movement dies at the ring boundary. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Update-Only Egress Valve
description: A Signature original: the egress valve fingerprints each update mirror's TLS certificate at first contact and pins it, refusing any mirror whose certificate changes mid-session. Pinning state survives reboots in a sealed store, defeating DNS-hijack update poisoning. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature State-Sealed Return Path
description: A Signature original: the state table entries are sealed with a per-boot secret, so a memory-corruption bug cannot forge 'established' state to smuggle packets in. Each entry also carries an idle deadline after which it self-destructs, bounding the window of any stale hole. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Adaptive ICMP Throttle
description: A Signature original: the throttle learns each source's normal ping cadence and tightens the limit automatically when a source deviates, instead of using one fixed global rate. Legitimate monitoring hosts keep working while flood sources get squeezed to near zero. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Resolver-Pinned DNS Gate
description: A Signature original: the gate signs every permitted DNS answer with the resolver's key and clients reject unsigned answers, closing the hole where malware answers its own queries locally. Pinning plus signing makes DNS tunneling measurably harder. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Scan-Fingerprint Trap
description: A Signature original: instead of a fixed threshold, the trap builds a behavioral fingerprint of each scanner - timing, order, and packet quirks - and shares fingerprints across the fleet. A scanner that rotates IPs is still recognized by its fingerprint and dropped everywhere at once. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Reputation-Weighted Geo Fence
description: A Signature original: the fence scores each region by live attack telemetry instead of a static allow/deny list, so a region is only blocked while it is actively hostile. Scores decay automatically, so blocks lift themselves when attacks stop - no manual list maintenance. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature QUIC Handshake Verifier
description: A Signature original: the allowance only opens after observing a complete valid QUIC handshake, rather than blindly permitting all UDP 443. Half-open or malformed handshakes are dropped, which blocks UDP-based exfiltration tools that abuse the port. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Dual-Key Management Airlock
description: A Signature original: management access additionally requires a time-boxed approval token countersigned by a second administrator, enforced by the firewall itself. title: Signature Predictive SYN Shield
description: A Signature original: the shield engages SYN cookies before the queue fills, triggered by a predictive model of handshake-completion ratios. It ramps protection gradually instead of flipping a cliff-edge switch, so legitimate traffic never sees a mode-change stutter. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Request-Semantics Firewall
description: A Signature original: the filter parses each request into a semantic action model - what the request actually tries to do - and judges that, not just strings in headers. title: Signature Tamper-Evident Deny Ledger
description: A Signature original: deny logs are hash-chained into a tamper-evident ledger, so an attacker who compromises the firewall cannot quietly erase the record of their blocked probes.
